title: Insperity Demonstrates Commitment to Small and Medium Sized Businesses at the 2026 Inc. 5000 Conference
summary: Explore Insperity's latest news, awards, and resources
body_markdown:
*Insperity will engage attendees in sessions exploring artificial intelligence (AI) and its significant impact in advancing HR.*


HOUSTON–([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/) )–[Insperity, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.insperity.com%2F&esheet=54620549&newsitemid=20261013032265&lan=en-US&anchor=Insperity%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=d946d9d011154917024b28df582d614a) (NYSE: NSP), a leading provider of human resources and business performance solutions, is showcasing its longstanding commitment to helping small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) grow as a 2026 presenting sponsor of the[Inc. 5000 Conference](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.inc.com%2F2026incconference&esheet=54620549&newsitemid=20261013032265&lan=en-US&anchor=Inc.+5000+Conference&index=2&md5=95866597654506c4c2d3f4b9f66f6312) this week in Dallas, Texas.


Building on more than 15 years at this premier event for growing businesses, Insperity will connect with founders, CEOs and business leaders to reinforce that an organization’s people strategy is critical to growth and navigating change.


“Leaders attending the Inc. 5000 Conference, many of whom are Insperity clients, are creating some of the fastest-growing companies in the country,” said Steve Arizpe, president and chief operating officer of Insperity. “Businesses today have an opportunity to think differently about HR, specifically how their people strategy must remain at the forefront of how they approach AI.”


**Insperity Leads Discussions on AI and Workforce Strategy**


New[research](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.insperity.com%2Fresources%2Freports%2Fthe-ai-balance-gap-why-people-strategy-is-the-key-to-turning-ai-investment-into-business-performance%2F&esheet=54620549&newsitemid=20261013032265&lan=en-US&anchor=research&index=3&md5=dd2e1df97d785e2f41046ec9acf0c902) from Insperity and Lighthouse Research & Advisory found that 83% of leaders say AI augments their people. Megg Withinton, Vice President of Enterprise Analytics at Insperity, will lead two on-site sessions exploring how businesses can better align their people strategies with emerging technology and long-term priorities:


- **A Marriage of Minds: Harmonizing AI and People Strategies** (Thursday, October 15 | 2:20-2:50 p.m.): Withinton will join Ben Eubanks, CEO and head of research at Lighthouse Research & Advisory, and David Stifter, CEO and founder of PredictAP, to discuss what it takes to blend AI and people strategies to deliver stronger teams, improved execution and a more adaptable business.
- **How Leaders Are Using HR as a Growth Lever** (Friday, October 16 | 10:10-10:30 a.m.): Withinton will explore findings from the latest Inc. 5000 CEO Survey and share insights into how high-growth companies are building AI readiness, strengthening soft skills, prioritizing adaptability and creating cultures designed to scale.


At Insperity’s conference booth (#2), leaders can learn how Insperity combines HR expertise and technology to help businesses navigate AI-driven change and drive scalable growth.


To learn more about Insperity’s solutions, visit[https://www.insperity.com/our-products/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.insperity.com%2Four-products%2F&esheet=54620549&newsitemid=20261013032265&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.insperity.com%2Four-products%2F&index=4&md5=98ecbca6ca010321c01a186e16660519) .


**About Insperity**


Since 1986, Insperity’s mission has been to help businesses succeed so communities prosper. Offering a suite of the most comprehensive, scalable HR solutions available in the marketplace, Insperity is defined by an unrivaled breadth and depth of services and level of care. Through an optimal blend of premium HR service and technology, Insperity delivers the administrative relief, reduced liabilities and better benefit solutions that businesses need to drive performance and growth. With 2025 revenues of $6.8 billion and sales and service operations throughout the U.S., Insperity is currently making a difference in thousands of businesses and communities nationwide. For more information, visit[https://www.insperity.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.insperity.com%2F&esheet=54620549&newsitemid=20261013032265&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.insperity.com&index=5&md5=05ffccd89a4c44d937c630d8f9eb61fd) .
